pr_title: Clarified fielddata not supported for text fields error message
pr_body:
Clarify where to start troubleshooting on IllegalArgumentException by telling the field and index name.

Closes #89485
pr_comments:
I need the following support from reviewers.

- Which is the preferred use of `name()`?
  1. Call it as many as necessary, as the overhead is ignorable.
  2. Combine them into `String name = name();`.
  3. Replace the second call with `it` or `the field`.
- How to kick off backport PR in a good manner after this PR? I will appreciate any reference/documentation.

Thanks.
Hi @sakurai-youhei, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

Hi @sakurai-youhei thanks for your contribution, I am a bit surprised that no tests are failing after changing the error message, maybe existing tests rely on substring. It would be good to update existing tests though to test the entire error message including the part that you added. Could you do that? We will take care of the rest, backporting etc. By the way the changelog too, it normally does not need editing, as it takes the needed info from the PR itself. Maybe you could update the title of the PR to something more descriptive like "Clarified fielddata not supported for text fields error message"?
Hi @sakurai-youhei, I've updated the changelog YAML for you.

- test code: That's because I drafted https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/89485 as minimum as possible plus not to break anything carefully. But I've updated the test code as per your advice. :)
- backporting, etc: I appreciate it very much!
- changelog: I didn't know how things work. I see, I leave as it is.

issue_context.title: Enhancement of "Text fields are not optimised for operations ..." log message
issue_context.body:
### Description

Users may see the below log message under various circumstances,

> https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/v8.3.3/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/mapper/TextFieldMapper.java#L899-L906
> Text fields are not optimised for operations that require per-document field data like aggregations and sorting, so these operations are disabled by default. Please use a keyword field instead. Alternatively, set fielddata=true on [FIELD_NAME] in order to load field data by uninverting the inverted index. Note that this can use significant memory.

as people seem to have mentioned this message in [Elasticsearch](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues?q=is%3Aissue+%22Text+fields+are+not+optimised+for+operations%22+), [Kibana](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues?q=is%3Aissue+%22Text+fields+are+not+optimised+for+operations%22+), and [Beats](https://github.com/elastic/beats/issues?q=is%3Aissue+%22Text+fields+are+not+optimised+for+operations%22+) GH issues as well as at [forums](https://discuss.elastic.co/search?q=%22Text%20fields%20are%20not%20optimised%20for%20operations%22).

I don't intend to suggest revise of this well-known message but want to propose an insertion of contextual information - i.e. field and index name to clarify where to start troubleshooting at a glance.

**Proposal**

```diff
diff --git a/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/mapper/TextFieldMapper.java b/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/mapper/TextFieldMapper.java
index 045be484f09..74df90ffc0f 100644
--- a/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/mapper/TextFieldMapper.java
+++ b/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/mapper/TextFieldMapper.java
@@ -909,7 +909,8 @@ public class TextFieldMapper extends FieldMapper {
             } else if (operation == FielddataOperation.SEARCH) {
                 if (fielddata == false) {
                     throw new IllegalArgumentException(
-                        "Text fields are not optimised for operations that require per-document "
+                        "Field data is disabled on [" + name() + "] in [" + fieldDataContext.fullyQualifiedIndexName() + "]. "
+                            + "Text fields are not optimised for operations that require per-document "
                             + "field data like aggregations and sorting, so these operations are disabled by default. Please use a "
                             + "keyword field instead. Alternatively, set fielddata=true on ["
                             + name()
```

If this proposal sounds reasonable, please let me know, and I will open PRs accordingly. Thanks.
comments: ++ @sakurai-youhei what you are suggesting makes sense, I would be glad to review your PR!
@javanna Thank you for your confirmation and kind offer. I've opened PR accordingly.

review_comments: @javanna Is this `field data` ok to have the white space between the words? If so, I will leave this as it is. Otherwise, I will also change here and the corresponding part in the test.
